summary: End-to-end test of Split-Cart Checkout, Merchant Storefront QR, and Weekly Payout card. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_split_cart_iter45.py (14 tests, ALL PASS) covering order creation with cart_group_id, POST /api/payments/checkout/session-multi (401 guard, empty-list guard, cross-user isolation, real Stripe URL), POST /api/orders/confirm-cod-multi (401 guard, cross-user isolation, multi-order confirm+persistence), and GET /api/merchant/payouts/weekly (401 guard, customer→404, restaurant owner→schema). UI drive of /cart + /checkout-group verified all data-testids (cart-store-*, cart-store-subtotal-*, cart-address-input, cart-grand-subtotal, cart-checkout-btn, group-grand-total, group-cod-btn, group-card-btn, group-wallet-btn, group-order-*). Clicking group-card-btn produced a real Stripe checkout URL (cs_live_...) — not completed, as instructed. Merchant dashboard drive: weekly-payout-card + weekly-payout-amount render correctly ($0 on a fresh merchant), Storefront and Grow dropdowns expose all expected items, QR dialog shows canvas + print button + encoded storefront URL.
action_items: Seed data gap (NOT a code bug, but blocks manual multi-store demo): Island Health Pharmacy (vendor b12146bb-4e6c-4eac-86fe-e7732ca616c9) has zero products and zero menu_items — /api/merchants/{id}/storefront returns 200 but with menu_items:[] and products:[]. As a result the /restaurant/{id} page renders no 'Add to Cart' buttons, so the split-cart UI can only be exercised with ONE store from the seeded set. Backend was still validated with 2 stores via direct POST /api/orders. Recommend seeding a few products on the pharmacy (and any other non-restaurant business storefronts) for repeatable UI demos.

GET /api/orders/confirm-cod-multi silently skips orders that don't belong to the caller and returns 200 with an empty order_ids list. This is safe (no data leaked) and is exactly how the code is written, but consider returning 403 (or at least surfacing the skipped count) for clearer client-side error handling.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py::create_multi_order_checkout_session (line ~7757) authorises orders by filtering on {'customer_id': current_user.id}, so cross-user attacks are correctly rejected with 404. Good.

server.py::confirm_orders_cod_multi (line ~3175) uses `continue` for foreign orders instead of raising — safe but silent. If ALL supplied ids are foreign the response is still {success:true, order_ids:[]}. Consider raising 404 when confirmed list is empty to help client callers detect misuse.

server.py::get_merchant_weekly_payout (line ~7635) uses `created_at: {'$gte': week_start}` where week_start is an ISO string — this works because create_order stores created_at as ISO via prepare_for_mongo, but is fragile if any code path writes native BSON datetime. Consider normalising the query.

MultiCart.js line 67 uses isLoggedIn() (checks localStorage.token) BEFORE calling placeAll. On the web login path localStorage.token is set to the 'cookie' sentinel; if a user never went through the web login (e.g. deep-linked from mobile), placeAll bounces to /login even if the httpOnly cookie is valid. Minor UX concern.

MultiCart.js line 87 sends delivery_address as {location: addr, full_address: addr} but Order model expects Dict[str, Any] — accepted but lacks lat/lng, which will hurt driver routing for split-cart orders. Consider geocoding on the cart page.

RestaurantMenu.js still lazy-loads via STOREFRONT_API and only shows 'Add to Cart' for menu_items. For business storefronts (grocery/pharmacy) whose catalog lives under /merchants/{id}/products, the storefront falls back to empty when the merchant has not published a menu — see Island Health Pharmacy repro.

seed_data_creation: Each test run registers 2-3 fresh customers (prefix split_cart_/ui_split_/ui_merch_) and, for the payout test, creates one fresh restaurant. conftest.py autouse fixture cleans up @test.com users after the session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_split_cart_iter45.py is safe to re-run any time; it hits Stripe live-mode session creation (session URL returned, no charge). Do NOT modify without preserving the cross-user isolation assertions. Seeded vendor Island Health Pharmacy has no products → UI can't add-to-cart from that storefront until main agent seeds products.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature working. Only environmental gap is missing product/menu seed data for non-restaurant seeded storefronts, which blocks a fully-UI multi-store demo but does not affect any code path.
